THE DEBUGGING QUESTION

Where did the symptom begin?

A 502 points toward a failing dependency. A 200 response with zero results can still break the product. The timeline gives each layer a named span so you can separate a transport error, slow query, and application-level empty result.

Opening the static HTML alone shows deterministic sample traces. Run the included Python server locally to record HTTP requests between the gateway and recommendation service and query the seeded SQLite database. Faults are injected.

REQUEST → GATEWAY → RECOMMENDATIONS → DATABASEFOUR CONTROLLED SCENARIOS
